serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
The Embrava Desk Sign is an all-in-one workspace solution for digital name plating, employee check-ins, instant booking, and availability display.

A federal employee can book a workspace (cubicle, office) in advance, and upon arrival in the office, tap their badge at the reserved workspace to check-in. The device displays the workspace name, employee name, reservation time, and color-coded status of the reservation.​

If the employee hasn’t booked in advance, they can tap their badge upon arrival at a free workspace, which automatically creates a reservation for the day. The employee can tap their badge when they are leaving to free up the space for the next employee.
